name: rest-api
title: REST API
description: A collection, its items and a nested collection, served across several HTTP methods by a single Function — routing on the path, at one version, rolled back as one unit.
post_deploy:
Your API is live at {{url}}

Every path beneath that address reaches this one Function, which routes it itself:
  curl {{url}}
  curl {{url}}/cus_amelia
  curl {{url}}/cus_amelia/orders
  curl -X POST {{url}} -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"Nadia Petrova","email":"nadia@example.com"}'
  curl {{url}}/nothing-here     # the Function's own 404

Then:
  1. Open src/store.ts — it serves fixture data and its writes are no-ops. That
     is the one file to replace with your database; the routes above do not change.
  2. Add or rename a route in the table at the top of src/index.ts.
  3. Watch requests land as they happen:
       wawesome logs --follow
  4. Shipped a bad route? Roll the Function back — the whole resource moves
     together, because it is one Function at one version.
